products.name: Heavyweight Crewneck
products.oneLiner: Oversized fleece with hypnotic electronic embroidery.
products.supplierBrief: 12–14 oz fleece crewneck, embroidered chest mark, numbered neck label, limited run.

description.text: Thick deep purple fleece features a subtle cyan geometric chest mark. The fabric feels dense and cozy, with a soft matte finish. Subtle yellow thread accents highlight the seams, creating a warm, streetwear-ready look that balances comfort with clean, modern lines.

products.name: Enamel Pin Set
products.oneLiner: Glossy electronic waveforms in vibrant enamel.
products.supplierBrief: Set of 3 hard-enamel pins, 1.25 in, butterfly clasps, mold fee applies.

description.text: Three small glossy pins display abstract cyan and hot pink waveforms against a deep purple base. The smooth enamel finish catches light sharply, evoking a retro-digital aesthetic. Silver metal edges frame the designs, offering a tactile, collectible accessory that pulses with subtle energy.

products.name: Heavyweight Tee
products.oneLiner: Bold graphic tee with neon electronic motifs.
products.supplierBrief: 6.5 oz cotton tee, 1–2 colour screen print front, small back print, sizes S–XXL.

description.text: Sturdy cotton in deep purple carries a large, crisp hot pink screen print of distorted audio waves. A small cyan geometric symbol sits near the hem. The fabric holds its shape, offering a structured, durable feel suitable for daily wear, with a modern, urban edge.

products.name: Embroidered Patch Set
products.oneLiner: Textured patches with neon electronic details.
products.supplierBrief: Set of 2 iron-on embroidered patches, 3 in, merrowed border, digitizing fee applies.

description.text: Two rectangular patches feature dense, raised embroidery in cyan and yellow on a dark purple background. The merrowed border adds a rugged, utilitarian touch. The thick thread creates deep texture, perfect for layering on jackets or bags, blending industrial workwear styles with digital precision.

products.name: Vinyl Sticker Pack
products.oneLiner: Waterproof stickers with glowing electronic shapes.
products.supplierBrief: Die-cut or kiss-cut vinyl stickers, 3 designs, waterproof, 100 min run.

description.text: Die-cut vinyl sheets feature abstract, glowing shapes in bright yellow and cyan. The glossy surface reflects light, mimicking a digital screen. Each sticker is smooth and durable, perfect for laptops or water bottles, offering a playful, vibrant pop of color that feels instantly modern.

products.name: Cassette-Style USB
products.oneLiner: Retro cassette USB with neon electronic art.
products.supplierBrief: Cassette-style 8 GB USB pre-loaded with the artist's own tracks, printed J-card insert.

description.text: A compact cassette-shaped drive features a printed label with swirling hot pink and cyan patterns. The matte plastic body feels nostalgic yet sleek. A small J-card insert displays the same hypnotic electronic motifs, blending vintage audio aesthetics with modern digital storage in a collectible form.

products.name: Corduroy Cap
products.oneLiner: Textured corduroy cap with electronic embroidery.
products.supplierBrief: Unstructured 6-panel corduroy cap, flat embroidery up to 3 colours, digitizing fee applies.

description.text: Deep purple corduroy provides a rich, ribbed texture on a soft, unstructured six-panel cap. A small, flat-embroidered cyan waveform sits centered on the front. The fabric feels durable and warm, with a casual, vintage workwear vibe that complements the clean, electronic design elements.
